body:
As far as I am aware packages do not have their own "status" states, and I don't know how one would compute the state from exports which can be mixed within a package (e.g. some exports could be experimental, while others are deprecated).

So until we decide to apply these states to packages as a whole, I will implement the first option given by @jenniferfell, which is to disable this drop-down when the type is being filtered as "package".

issue.title: feat(docs-infra): disable "status" selector in API list when displaying only packages
